description: Trigger evals for mcp-server-vet: it fires when a third-party MCP server has not been trusted yet and its tools, scopes and env surface need a safety look, while skill-vet, security-review, capture-references and review-hard handle third-party skills, first-party security, saving web sources, and general risk review.

should_trigger: Someone shared a GitHub MCP server on a forum and I want to put it in .mcp.json. Is it safe to add?
vet this mcp server before I trust it
I cloned a community Postgres MCP server into ~/quarantine/pg-mcp. Read its tool descriptions and input schemas and tell me whether to add, decline or sandbox it.
Before we wire in this third-party Slack connector, check whether its tool descriptions carry hidden instructions and what env vars and scopes it asks for.
The README for this file-system MCP looks fine but it exposes 14 tools. Compare what it declares with what the tools can actually reach, and check for egress.

should_not_trigger.prompt: There is a marketplace plugin with a SKILL.md and a helper script that I want to install. Look through the whole folder first.
Review the auth changes in my current branch for security problems, threat model and secrets.
Grab this vendor's API docs page, summarize it with a freshness note and store it in REFERENCES.md.
We wrote our own MCP server in this repo. Review the diff for correctness and maintainability risks before we close the slice.
Is this npm package for date parsing well maintained, and what are the top alternatives by downloads?
